headline: China mandates 70% homegrown silicon wafer use, accelerating critical chip supply chain localization amidst AI boom and export restrictions.
summary: Beijing's ambitious target for 70% domestic silicon wafer production represents a significant escalation in the global tech war, directly impacting semiconductor fabs and AI infrastructure worldwide. This strategic move aims to achieve chip supply chain self-sufficiency, intensifying decoupling pressures and potentially leading to market fragmentation and higher costs for all players reliant on the global semiconductor ecosystem.
